- Anchored bundle pricing: we can offer an anchored list price that maps to an equivalent of ~200 node-hours per month. For a 12-month commit the list price we suggest is $72,000/year; with an early-adopter credit we can net to $64,800 for year one.

Marcus —

Quick notes from marketplace ops/legal perspective:

1) Publishing margin in the PO: not recommended to show a separate "reseller margin" line inside the marketplace private-offer. Marketplaces typically require list price visibility and can reject offers that show third-party margin line items. Instead: create a single line item for the bundled SKU at the list price, and include an "Integrators fee" in the SOW that lives outside the marketplace invoice. This keeps the PO clean and avoids platform pushback.

2) Post-invoice rebate flow: proven approach is to: (a) have the integrator invoice Aventis separately for their services (or we issue a reimbursement to the integrator from Redwood after purchase) OR (b) use our partner pass-through where the integrator is listed as the reseller in the PO and Redwood books revenue net of the integrator margin. Option (b) is preferable if the integrator is an approved marketplace reseller and can appear on the PO.

3) Onboarding credit: $7,200 upfront is fine but treat it as a one-time service credit in the SOW (deliverable-based). Avoid embedding it as a negative line in marketplace billing; instead show it in the SOW and adjust Redwood's internal revenue recognition accordingly.

I've made edits to the attached channel_margin_model.xlsx with two scenario tabs: "Reseller-as-PO" and "Rebate-after-invoice". Also flagged tax treatment notes for US state sales tax where applicable.

I can draft suggested SOW language for the invoice routing and credit treatment if you'd like — copying Vanessa for final commercial sign-off.

-Irene
